about_the_game:
Lost Vulcan (Demo) – A roguelite platformer reviving the spirit of classic arcade games!
The legend of Vulcan calls you... will you answer the challenge?

Deep in space lies Vulcan, a colossal abandoned ship hiding legendary treasures, deadly traps, and foes that will push even the most seasoned bounty hunters to their limits.

Master the art of arcade survival:

  • 🎮 Precision controls with classic-style gameplay and modern roguelite depth.

  • 🧩 2 unique zones filled with clever traps and ruthless enemies (full version: 6 zones).

  • 💥 2 epic bosses to test your skills (full version: 7 bosses).

  • 🔄 More than 30 handcrafted levels ensuring no two runs are alike. (a lot more on the full version!)

  • 🎮 Local multiplayer: Team up in co-op or compete in versus mode!

  • 🏆 Leaderboards: Compete for the highest scores in each run.

  • 🎵 Chiptune soundtrack straight from gaming’s golden age.

Do you dare to risk it all for the treasure? In Lost Vulcan, every jump and every shot could mean the difference between glory... and an untimely demise.

(The demo offers a taste of the full experience. Unlock more characters and upgrades in the final version!)
